## Data

- Shipping Arrivals at Cape of Good Hope provided by IMF Portwatch and Oxford University <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/sctl0dsd72wubxfrn7ko0v6namn9fhl4.csv>

- Shipping Arrivals at Strait of Hormuz provided by IMF Portwatch and Oxford University <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/bbupg81yyw6ynzktv1bcebgggxq2cizd.csv>

- Shipping Arrivals at Strait of Hormuz provided by IMF Portwatch and Oxford University <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/765ueln3kmknv8498wv6a9e6qh9vheui.xlsx>

- Data Science Jobs Postings provided by Glassdoor via web-scraping by Kaggle user Rashik Rahman <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/5nqg2dk8uym5u87s9rv1gq10mtxnybij.txt>

- Greatest of All Time Artists and their Songs provided by Billboard and Spotify <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/omj8z0gb2zivcuhn5fhqt0n8ahvxwes4.json>

- Highest Grossing Films provided by Box Office Mojo, an IMDB company <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/drhbcntw0g73u29m79t9yl8q4oocgir7.xlsx>

- Food Inspections in year 2021 provided by City of Chicago <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/2lh0lmn0itb3uchduvzkj1f43ju4he0j.csv>

- The Complete Works of William Shakespeare provided by Project Gutenberg <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/19qhj5fmlvo1a3mwf22gx31j5h9oh9o8.txt>

- Trump Tweets 2017-2019 provided by Trump Twitter Archive and Twitter <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/sf65zjc2s9xhpy6npnw21edai61evhnl.txt>

- Audio file provided by Loopmasters <https://uofi.box.com/shared/static/vmmaky1fe5wgv9z4vnzrsln1why3jg8u.wav>

## APIs

- National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration / National Weather Service (NOAA/NWS) API <https://openweathermap.org/api>

- OpenWeatherMap API <https://openweathermap.org/api>

- The Open Movie Database (OMDb) API <http://www.omdbapi.com>
